questions.question: The cable stays AB and AD help support pole AC. Knowing that the tension is 120 lb in AB and 40 lb in AD, determine the magnitude and direction of the resultant of the forces exerted by the stays at A.
choices: $139.1\text{ lb}$ at $67.0^\circ$ down and to the left
$112.5\text{ lb}$ at $35.7^\circ$ down and to the left

$126.5\text{ lb}$ at $67.0^\circ$ down and to the left

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If $P = 75\text{ N}$ and $Q = 125\text{ N}$, determine the magnitude of the resultant force at point A.
questions.situation_text: Two forces P and Q are applied at point A of a hook support. Force P is directed $20^\circ$ to the left of the downward vertical, and force Q is directed $35^\circ$ to the right of the downward vertical.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: For the same loading condition ($P = 75\text{ N}$ and $Q = 125\text{ N}$), determine the direction of the resultant force measured from the horizontal.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: f the loads are changed to $P = 60\text{ lb}$ and $Q = 25\text{ lb}$, determine the magnitude and direction of the resultant force at point A.
choices: $77.6\text{ lb}$ at $85.0^\circ$ down and to the left
$77.6\text{ lb}$ at $5.0^\circ$ down and to the left
$50.8\text{ lb}$ at $85.0^\circ$ down and to the left
$77.6\text{ lb}$ at $85.0^\circ$ down and to the right

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: Knowing that $\alpha = 25^\circ$, determine the magnitude of the force P so that the resultant force exerted on the trolley is vertical.
questions.situation_text: A trolley that moves along a horizontal beam is acted upon by two forces at point $A$: a $1600\text{ N}$ force directed $15^\circ$ below the horizontal to the left, and a force P directed at an angle $\alpha$ to the right of the downward vertical.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: For the same condition where $\alpha = 25^\circ$ and the resultant force is vertical, what is the corresponding magnitude of the resultant?

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If the angle $\alpha$ is not fixed, determine the magnitude and direction $\alpha$ of the force P so that the resultant is a vertical force of $2500\text{ N}$.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: Knowing that $\alpha = 20^\circ$, determine the required magnitude of the force P if the resultant R of the two forces applied at $A$ is to be vertical.
questions.situation_text: A steel tank is to be positioned in an excavation by two forces applied at point A: a $425\text{ lb}$ force directed $30^\circ$ above the horizontal to the left, and a force P directed at an angle $\alpha$ above the horizontal to the right

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: For the same condition where $\alpha = 20^\circ$ and the resultant R is vertical, determine the corresponding magnitude of R.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If the magnitude of P is instead set to $500\text{ lb}$, determine the required angle $\alpha$ so that the resultant R is vertical, along with the corresponding magnitude of R.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: Determine the angle $\theta$ which makes the resultant of the two forces vertical.
questions.situation_text: Two forces are applied in the x-y plane to the construction bracket as shown: $F_1 = 800\text{ lb}$ directed down and to the right at $70^\circ$ below the negative x-axis, and $F_2 = 425\text{ lb}$ directed down and to the left at an angle $\theta$ below the positive x-axis.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: Using the angle $\theta$ found in Item 1, determine the magnitude $R$ of the vertical resultant.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If the angle $\theta$ is instead fixed at $30^\circ$ while keeping $F_1 = 800\text{ lb}$ at $70^\circ$, what magnitude must $F_2$ have so that the resultant remains purely vertical?

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If the tension in cable AB is $8\text{ kN}$, determine the required tension T in cable AC such that the net effect of the two cable tensions is a purely downward force at point A.
questions.situation_text: The guy cables AB and AC are attached to the transmission tower at point A, which is $50\text{ m}$ above the ground ($30\text{ m} + 20\text{ m}$). Anchor B is on level ground $40\text{ m}$ to the left of the tower base, while anchor C is on a slope $50\text{ m}$ to the right of the tower base and $20\text{ m}$ above the ground ($30\text{ m}$ below point A).

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: Under this loading condition ($T_{AB} = 8\text{ kN}$ and a purely vertical resultant), determine the magnitude R of the downward force at point A

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If the anchor at C is relocated to level ground at the same $50\text{ m}$ horizontal distance to the right of the tower (making the vertical drop from A to C equal to $50\text{ m}$), what tension T in cable AC is required to keep the resultant force at A purely vertical when $T_{AB} = 8\text{ kN}$?

questions.question: The magnitudes of the three forces applied to the eye bolt are $T_1 = 110\text{ lb}$, $T_2 = 40\text{ lb}$, and $T_3 = 150\text{ lb}$. Replace these forces with a single equivalent force $\mathbf{R}$.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If the resultant force of the two tugboats is $3\text{ kN}$ directed along the positive x-axis, determine the required magnitude of force $\mathbf{F}_B$ and its direction $\theta$
questions.situation_text: Two tugboats A and B pull a barge C at a common attachment point. Tugboat A exerts a force $F_A = 2\text{ kN}$ directed $30^\circ$ above the positive x-axis, while tugboat B exerts a force $\mathbf{F}_B$ directed at an angle $\theta$ below the positive x-axis.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If instead $F_B = 3\text{ kN}$ and $\theta = 45^\circ$, determine the magnitude of the resultant force of the two tugboats and its direction measured clockwise from the positive x-axis.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If the resultant force of the two tugboats is required to be directed along the positive $x$-axis and $\mathbf{F}_B$ is to be a minimum, determine the magnitude of $\mathbf{F}_R$, $\mathbf{F}_B$, and the angle $\theta$.
